plan.title: Donation Dashboard
plan.subtitle: Monthly donation trends, top cities, payment modes, and repeat donors

panels.title: Total donations
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM donor_transactions

panels.title: Total amount
panels.sql: SELECT SUM(Amount) AS n FROM donor_transactions

panels.title: Average donation
panels.sql: SELECT AVG(Amount) AS n FROM donor_transactions

panels.title: Top cities
panels.sql: SELECT City, COUNT(*) AS count FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Payment modes
panels.sql: SELECT Mode, COUNT(*) AS count FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Repeat donors
panels.sql: SELECT Donor, COUNT(*) AS count FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
